name: Donghua Wonderland
description: Donghua Wonderland is the residence of the ancient gods, a secluded pure land located in the outer sky. The silver moon shines here, gathering the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, cranes dance in groups, clouds and mist linger, and the scenery is poetic and picturesque. Donghua Wonderland (3D metal puzzle) depicts a beautiful artistic conception in a romantic style, with pavilions, pavilions, and verandas connected, with flowing gold, clouds, water blue, and elegant white complementing each other, making it dreamy and ethereal. The door to the fairyland is open, and Pinku invites you to explore the wonderful wonderland through assembly.
